description: This source file defines the `SerializerConfigurationValidator` class, which implements the `IConfigurationValidator` interface. The class is responsible for validating serialization configuration in the Orleans framework, analyzing serializer availability and ensuring all relevant types have appropriate serializers and copiers.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationValidator
classes.description: A class that validates serializer configuration, checking the availability of serializers and copiers for types used in grain interfaces, and throwing exceptions if issues are found.

methods.name: SerializerConfigurationValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with dependencies and determines whether validation is enabled based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs the validation of serializer configuration, analyzing serializer availability and throwing an exception with details if issues are detected.
